title: Design thinking — d.school 5 stages
problem_statement: Engineering-led design builds things nobody wants. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Stanford d.school/IDEO design thinking: Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test — human-centered iteration with cheap prototypes and real user feedback. Crossover note: the power here is the domain transfer — state explicitly what each domain contributes.
novelty_assessment: Desirability given equal weight with feasibility and viability.
validation_plan: Prototype test scores before/after adopting the process
Document the outcome honestly whether it confirms or kills the concept.
